reference.sourceDescription: FlahaX target-pH reference generated with the official USGS PHREEQC 3.8.6-17100 Windows batch release and phreeqc.dat at 25 C. Fix_H+ adds HNO3 to reach pH 6.0 in a complete stated Ca/Mg/P/C/S/K/Na/NO3/Cl solution.

phreeqcInput:
TITLE FlahaX target-pH nitric-acid reference
PHASES
Fix_H+
    H+ = H+
    -log_k 0
SOLUTION 1
    temp 25
    pH 7.4
    units mmol/kgw
    Ca 1
    Mg 1
    N(5) 3 as NO3
    P 1 as H2PO4
    S(6) 1 as SO4
    C 2.4 as HCO3
    K 2
    Na 3
    Cl 7
EQUILIBRIUM_PHASES 1
    Fix_H+ -6.0 HNO3 1
SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -file target_ph_nitric_dose.sel
    -reset false
    -pH true
    -ionic_strength true
    -totals Ca Mg P C S(6) N(5) K Na Cl
    -molalities Ca+2 Mg+2 PO4-3 HPO4-2 H2PO4- CO3-2 HCO3- SO4-2 K+ Na+ NO3- Cl-
    -activities Ca+2 Mg+2 PO4-3 CO3-2 SO4-2 H+
    -si Calcite Gypsum Hydroxyapatite
    -equilibrium_phases Fix_H+
END
